title: Lesson 21: Case Study: A Real Agent Engagement, End to End
description: One composite agent engagement from first call to handover, told in sequence with the mistakes left in, so the reader learns the sequencing of qualification, baseline, build, stakeholders, handover, and close.

questions.question: Per the lesson about the real agent engagement case study, what is the central focus?
options: One agent engagement from first call to handover, told in sequence with the mistakes left in, to teach sequencing over techniques
A review of unrelated sales tools
A history of the ERP vendor
questions.explanation: The lesson runs twenty techniques together in sequence because the sequence is the part no single technique lesson can teach.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson's guidance?
options: Absorb the duplicate-SKU cleanup into the engagement because you are in the data anyway
Name a client defect with evidence and refuse to own it, pricing around it instead of absorbing it
Keep silent to the sponsor about the Tuesday the export changed
Decline the follow-on order entry work without explaining why
questions.explanation: The lesson teaches that rolling the cleanup in would cost unpaid days, make exclusions soft, and hide a data governance problem, so you name the defect and refuse to own it.

questions.question: Which conclusion does the lesson support?
options: A handover is written on the last day so it describes the final system
Measurement is defined after the change so it fits the result
Design for a loud failure that stops rather than producing plausible output from unexpected input
The golden set is graded by the delivered system itself
questions.explanation: The lesson teaches that the most valuable build decision is that the pipeline stops rather than produces plausible output, so failures are loud and diagnosable.
